messages:
Ben: Hi team, Ben starting today. My new laptop (USB-C only) doesn't output to the Dell U2723QE via the provided USB-C cable  monitor shows "No signal" even though it charges. Display works if I plug an external older DP monitor via a USB-C->DP dongle I had at home. Any ideas?
it-ops: hey Ben, welcome! Quick question: does the cable that shipped have the red tag (looks like thunderbolt/alt-mode certified) or is it just a plain USB-C cable? Also are you on the company image?
Ben: company MacBook Pro M2, imaged. The cable in the box is plain black with no tag. Vendor packing slip lists "USB-C cable (data+power)".
shipping-bot: Package 48721 scanned 2026-04-02 10:05 PST. Shipped items: Dell U2723QE, USB-C cable (type: usb2/usb3 unknown), DisplayPort adapter NOT included. Manifest flag: cable_generic=true. Claim VC-10012 opened.
it-ops: that sounds like a bandwidth mismatch. Some cheaper USB-C cables only support power and USB2 data and don't expose DP Alt Mode or TB signals, so the monitor charges but gets no DisplayPort. Two quick options: 1) loan a certified USB-C 40Gbps or USB-C->DP adapter from spares, 2) RMA the cable.
Ben: I can test with my personal TB cable but prefer company loaner.
it-bot: created ticket INC-6123 for Ben (priority: medium)  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-6123
Avery: hey Ben, I'm IT on site. I can drop off a USB-C 40Gbps cable and a USB-C->DP alt-mode adapter in 40m. Also note that for 4k@60 you need either DisplayPort alt-mode on the cable or a TB3/4 host connection.
Ben: thanks! curious: when the monitor reports "No signal" is there a quick way to confirm it's the cable not the monitor?
it-ops: yes: 1) If the monitor OSD shows "USB-C Power" but no DisplayPort/HDMI input active, that's usually cable. 2) Check System Information -> Thunderbolt/USB4 or System Report -> USB to see if the external display is enumerated. 3) Try a direct USB-C->HDMI adapter (if you have one) to narrow down.
Ben: checked System Report: USB device enumerated as "Apple USB-C Charge" with no DisplayPort controller listed. So sounds cable-related.
Avery: dropped off a loaner cable + adapter at Ben's desk (SF-2, desk 21). Ben: can you try now?
Ben: plugged the loaner cable in  monitor came up at 4k@60! Colors/OSD look good. Thanks Avery.
it-ops: great. We'll mark INC-6123 in-progress and note loaner items (usb-c_40g_cable, usb-c_dp_adapter). Shipping claim VC-10012 will request vendor send certified USB-C alt-mode cable.
it-bot: Vendor claim VC-10012 updated: vendor acknowledging pick/pack error; replacement cable (USB4 40Gbps alt-mode) shipping, ETA 4 business days.
Avery: Ben please return loaner cable/adapter to IT dropbox when vendor cable arrives and update INC-6123 so we can close it.
Ben: will do. One more q: is there a KB on cable types and what to ask for? I wasn't sure what "alt-mode" meant.
it-ops: good point. KB: "USB-C cable types for displays" added to onboarding KBs: TL;DR look for USB-C 40Gbps / USB4 or Thunderbolt label, or "supports DP Alt Mode". We'll link the KB in the ticket.
Ben: awesome, thanks all and glad it's an easy fix. Happy to be here! :smile:
